grain_rationale: row_count is 13014 and duplicate_row_rate is 0.0, so the source carries no exact duplicate rows to absorb. airport_code has distinct_count 3 and observed_hour_utc has distinct_count 4341; the product of these two cardinalities (about 13023) is close to row_count, showing observed_hour_utc repeats across the three airports rather than being unique on its own, so neither column alone identifies a row. The pair (airport_code, observed_hour_utc) is therefore the natural line identity for one hourly observation at one airport, and this transaction grain is used with a derived identifier over that pair.

fields.name: airport_code
fields.description: Three-letter airport code with distinct_count 3 and sample values EWR, JFK, LGA, and null_rate 0.0; identifies which of the three NYC airports the observation belongs to and participates in the line identity with observed_hour_utc.

fields.name: observed_hour_utc
fields.description: UTC timestamp of the hourly observation with null_rate 0.0; samples such as 2013-01-01T06:00:00 through 2013-01-01T15:00:00 land exactly on the hour, so this is the time column at hour grain.

fields.name: observed_date_local
fields.description: Local calendar date of the observation with distinct_count 181 and null_rate 0.0, ranging 2013-01-01 to 2013-06-30; a local-date dimension distinct from the UTC time column.

fields.name: observed_hour_local
fields.description: Local hour of day stored as an integer 0 through 23 with distinct_count 24 and null_rate 0.0; labels the local hour rather than measuring a quantity.

fields.name: temp_f
fields.description: Air temperature in degrees Fahrenheit, null_rate 0.0, ranging 10.94 to 93.92 across 130 distinct values per the operator context's unit note; a quantity compared and averaged across observations.

fields.name: dewpoint_f
fields.description: Dewpoint in degrees Fahrenheit, null_rate 0.0, ranging -9.94 to 73.94 across 119 distinct values; a measured quantity per the operator context's unit note.

fields.name: humidity_pct
fields.description: Relative humidity percentage, null_rate 0.0, ranging 12.74 to 100.0 across 2178 distinct values; a measured quantity compared across observations.

fields.name: wind_dir_degrees
fields.description: Wind direction in compass degrees 0 to 360 with distinct_count 37 and null_rate 0.016828 (219 nulls, likely calm-wind readings); labels a direction rather than a summable quantity, so it is nullable.

fields.name: wind_speed_mph
fields.description: Wind speed in mph, null_rate 0.000154 (2 nulls), ranging 0.0 to 1048.36058 across 36 distinct values per the operator context's unit note; a measured quantity, nullable for the rare missing reading.

fields.name: wind_gust_mph
fields.description: Wind gust speed in mph, null_rate 0.745505 (9702 nulls of 13014 rows), ranging 16.11092 to 62.14212 across 35 distinct values; a measured quantity that is nullable because gusts are only recorded when they occur.

fields.name: precip_inches
fields.description: Precipitation in inches, null_rate 0.0, ranging 0.0 to 1.06 across 50 distinct values per the operator context's unit note; a measured, summable quantity.

fields.name: pressure_mb
fields.description: Barometric pressure in millibars, null_rate 0.114953 (1496 nulls), ranging 983.8 to 1038.4 across 430 distinct values; a measured quantity, nullable where the reading is missing.

fields.name: visibility_miles
fields.description: Visibility in miles, null_rate 0.0, with 20 distinct values ranging 0.0 to 10.0 per the capped distinct_values list; a measured quantity per the operator context's unit note.

fields.name: airport_name
fields.description: Full airport name with distinct_count 3 (John F. Kennedy International Airport, LaGuardia Airport, Newark Liberty International Airport) and null_rate 0.0; a descriptive dimension from the OurAirports join noted as complete in the operator context.

fields.name: airport_municipality
fields.description: Airport's municipality with distinct_count 2 (New York, Newark) and null_rate 0.0; a descriptive dimension from the airports reference join.

fields.name: airport_elevation_ft
fields.description: Airport elevation in feet with distinct_count 3 (13, 18, 21) and null_rate 0.0; a fixed airport attribute that labels rather than measures a per-observation quantity.

fields.name: airport_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: Longest runway length in feet with distinct_count 3 (7002, 11000, 14511) and null_rate 0.0; a fixed airport attribute, not a per-observation measure.

fields.name: captured_at
fields.description: Ingestion timestamp with distinct_count 3 and null_rate 0.0, sample values 2026-09-02T23:26:11 through 2026-09-02T23:26:13; a technical capture-time dimension distinct from the business time column observed_hour_utc.

category_description: One row represents a single hourly weather observation recorded at one of the three New York City area airports (JFK, LGA, EWR), combining the nycflights13 hourly reading with that airport's static OurAirports reference attributes.
purpose: This mapping declares how silver.silver_airport_weather enters the gold unified event star as the airport_weather_observations fact category, naming its time column, grain, and field roles for the deterministic modeling engine that renders the gold models from the validated contract.
usage: The deterministic renderer turns this proposal into an ODCS mapping contract draft identified as gold_airport_weather_observations_mapping, the frozen mapping-contract schema and datacontract lint validate the render, and a human reviewer edits and approves the draft before the modeling engine consumes it to generate gold models.
limitations: The mapping does not impute or filter missing readings: wind_gust_mph is null on about 74.6% of rows, pressure_mb on about 11.5%, wind_dir_degrees on about 1.7%, and wind_speed_mph on a negligible fraction; handling of these nulls, and any exclusion or imputation, is left to downstream consumers. The mapping also does not aggregate or deduplicate beyond the airport-and-hour identity it declares.
